paite: Huan huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, Ammon suante kumpipa Nahash asi a, asik in atapa in vai ahawm hi.
heading: David In Ammonte Leh Siriate Azou / (2 Sam 10.1-19)

paite: David in, "Apa'n hon na hehpih zel ziak in ke'n leng Nahash tapa Hanun ka hehpih sam ding," achi a. Huchi in David in apa tungtang thu a lungmuan ding in mite asawl hi. Huan David mite Ammon suante gam ah Hanun kiang ah amah lungmuan ding in ava tung uhi.

Himahleh Ammon suan heutute'n Hanun kiang ah, "David in na pa azahtak ziak a lungmuan ding mi na kiang a hon sawl hi in na gingta a hia? Amite gam hihse ding a enchian leh enkhe ding a na kiang a hong pai ahi khamoh ding uam maw?" achi uhi.
Huchi in Hanun in David mite aman a, akhamul uh ametmaisak a, huan apuansilhte uh alaitak ah atobou uh khuhpha minmen in atansak a, apaisakta hi.

Huchi in kuate hiam in amite ana hihdan David ava hilh ua. Huan adawn ding in mi asawl a; amau lah azum mahmah ngal uhi. Kumpipa'n, "Na khamul uh asau nawn ma Jeriko ah om unla, huai zoh chiang in hong kik un," achi hi.

Huchi in Ammon suante'n David zakdah lam ana hihta uh chih akitheih un, Hanun leh Ammon suante'n Mesopotamia gam a mite, Siria-maakah a mite, Zobah a mite, kangtalai leh sakol tungtuang mite goihna ding in dangkasik talent sangkhat akhak uhi.
Huchi in kangtalai singthum-le- sangnih, Maakah kumpipa leh amite toh api ua, Medeba kiang ah panmun abawlta uhi. Ammon suante akhua ua kipan apawtkhia ua, akikaikhawm ua, kidou ding in akuanta uhi.
David in huai azak in, Joab leh sepaih hangsante tengteng asawlkhia hi.
Ammon suante ahong kuan ua, khopi kongpi chin ah akiphalh ua, kumpipa amau thu a hong kuante atuam in loubuk ah a-om uhi.
Huchi in amalam leh nunglam ah ahon sual dek uh chih Joab in atheih in Israel mite lak a mi teltuamte atelkhia a, Siria mite sual ding in akizalh uhi.
Midang tengteng bel a-unaupa Abishai khut ah akoih vek a, Ammon suante sual ding in amau leng akizalh uhi.
Huchi in ama'n, "Siria mite ka zoh kei dekleh, hon panpih in; Ammon suante na zoh kei dekleh ka hon panpih ding.
Hangsantak in om unla, i mite leh i Pathian khuate hum in i kipasalsak ding uh; TOUPA'N hoih asak bang zel in hih hen," achi hi.
Huchi in Joab leh akiang a mite'n kidouna mun a Siria mite ava naih ua; huchi in ama ah ataikekta uhi.
Ammon suante'n Siria mite ataikek uh chih atheih un amau leng a-unaupa Abishai ma ah ataikekta ua, khua ah alut uhi. Huchi in Joab Jerusalem ah apaita hi.
Siria mite'n Israelte ma ah apang thei kei uh chih ana theih un, mi asawl ua, Lui khen lam a Siria pawlte asamkhia ua, Hadadezer sepaih heutu Shophak bel aheutupen uh ahi.
Huai thu David ahilh ua; ama'n Israel mi tengteng asamkhawm a, Jordan lui akan ua, ava mu ua, sual ding in akiphalh uhi. Huchi in Siriate kidoupih dia David akisak khit in amah akidoupihta uhi.
Siria mite bel Israelte ma ah ataikek ua; David in Siria mi, kangtalai sangsagih tung a tuang leh sepaih singli athat a, sepaih heutu Shophak leng athat hi.
Huchi in Hadadezer mite'n Israelte ma ah apang theita kei uh chih atheih un, David toh kilemna abawl ua, asikhate ding in a-omta uh; Siria mite'n leng Ammon suante apanpih nuamta kei uhi.
